package pages

type Order {
  id: string
  total: int
}

// A record carrying settled and pending members together. The name is an
// ordinary value the fallback subtree may render while the orders are still on
// their way.
type Customer {
  name: string
  orders: async Order[]
}

type Row {
  label: string
  count: async int
}

external async LoadBadge(name: string): string

export component Layout(customer: Customer, children: html): html {
<header>
{await orders = customer.orders}
  <span class="count">{for order in orders}<i>{order.id}</i>{/for}</span>
{fallback}
  <span class="count-pending"></span>
{/await}
</header>
<main>{children}</main>
}

export component Profile(customer: Customer, headline: async string?): html {
<section>
<h1>{customer.name}</h1>
{await orders = customer.orders, badge = LoadBadge(customer.name)}
  <p class="badge">{badge}</p>
  <ul>{for order in orders}<li>{order.id}: {order.total}</li>{/for}</ul>
{fallback}
  <p class="pending">loading {customer.name}…</p>
{recover err}
  <p class="failed">{err.code}</p>
{/await}
{await note = headline}
  <p class="note" title={note}>note</p>
{fallback}
  <p class="note-pending"></p>
{/await}
</section>
}

export component Rows(rows: Row[]): html {
<ul>
{for row in rows}
  {await count = row.count}
    <li>{row.label}: {count}</li>
  {fallback}
    <li>{row.label}: pending</li>
  {/await}
{/for}
</ul>
}
